model WebBackgroundJob {
  id String @id
  userId String @map("user_id")
  familyId String @map("family_id")
  babyId String @map("baby_id")
  kind String
  clientRequestId String @map("client_request_id")
  requestHash String @map("request_hash") @db.Char(64)
  input Json @db.JsonB
  claimed Boolean @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  task TaskExecution @relation(fields: [id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  family Family @relation(fields: [familyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  baby Baby @relation(fields: [familyId,babyId], references: [familyId,id], onDelete: Cascade)
  retries WebJobRetry[]
  @@unique([userId,kind,clientRequestId], map: "web_background_jobs_request_uq")
  @@index([userId,createdAt(sort: Desc),id(sort: Desc)], map: "web_background_jobs_user_created")
  @@map("web_background_jobs")
  @@schema("public")
}
model WebJobRetry {
  jobId String @map("job_id")
  commandId String @map("command_id")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  job WebBackgroundJob @relation(fields: [jobId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@id([jobId,commandId])
  @@map("web_job_retries")
  @@schema("public")
}
model WebVoiceLog {
  id String @id
  userId String @map("user_id")
  familyId String @map("family_id")
  babyId String @map("baby_id")
  prompt String
  reply String
  isAsync Boolean @default(false) @map("is_async")
  isFastPath Boolean @default(false) @map("is_fast_path")
  acknowledged Boolean @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  family Family @relation(fields: [familyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  baby Baby @relation(fields: [familyId,babyId], references: [familyId,id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([userId,createdAt(sort: Desc),id(sort: Desc)], map: "web_voice_logs_user_created")
  @@map("web_voice_logs")
  @@schema("public")
}
model WebHistoryImport {
  userId String @map("user_id")
  kind String
  sourceId String @map("source_id")
  targetId String @map("target_id")
  payloadHash String @map("payload_hash") @db.Char(64)
  payload Json @db.JsonB
  importedAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("imported_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@id([userId,kind,sourceId])
  @@map("web_history_imports")
  @@schema("public")
}

model WebChatRetry {
  runId String @map("run_id")
  commandId String @map("command_id")
  run AiRun @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@id([runId, commandId])
  @@map("web_chat_retries")
}

model WebSessionCommand {
  userId String @map("user_id")
  commandId String @map("command_id")
  sessionId String @map("session_id")
  requestHash String @map("request_hash")
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@id([userId, commandId])
  @@map("web_session_commands")
}
